'''Garrum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was serving in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]]<ref name="War Droids" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> During that year, he was observing the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was assigned by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza|Garza]] to give [[Havoc Squad]] a mission to neutralize a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] inventor named [[Krel]] along with his inventions.<ref name="War Droids" />
